# Sign Up To Our Mailing List

Fields marked with \* are required.

```{=html}
<form id="signup" class="mb-3">

  <div class="mb-3">
    <label for="first_name" class="form-label">First name *</label>
    <input id="first_name" name="first_name" type="text" class="form-control" required>
  </div>

  <div class="mb-3">
    <label for="family_name" class="form-label">Family name *</label>
    <input id="family_name" name="family_name" type="text" class="form-control" required>
  </div>

  <div class="mb-3">
    <label for="institution" class="form-label">Institution or company where you work *</label>
    <input id="institution" name="institution" type="text" class="form-control" required>
  </div>

  <div class="mb-3">
    <label for="department" class="form-label">Department / area of research *</label>
    <input id="department" name="department" type="text" class="form-control" required>
  </div>

  <fieldset class="mb-3" data-other-group="career_stage">
    <legend class="fs-6">Which best describes your career stage *</legend>
    <div class="form-check">
      <input class="form-check-input" type="radio" id="cs1" name="career_stage" value="Early career" required>
      <label class="form-check-label" for="cs1">Early career</label>
    </div>
    <div class="form-check">
      <input class="form-check-input" type="radio" id="cs2" name="career_stage" value="Mid career">
      <label class="form-check-label" for="cs2">Mid career</label>
    </div>
    <div class="form-check">
      <input class="form-check-input" type="radio" id="cs3" name="career_stage" value="Late career researcher">
      <label class="form-check-label" for="cs3">Late career researcher</label>
    </div>
    <div class="form-check d-flex align-items-center gap-2">
      <input class="form-check-input mt-0" type="radio" id="cs4" name="career_stage" value="Other">
      <label class="form-check-label" for="cs4">Other:</label>
      <input type="text" class="form-control form-control-sm w-auto" name="career_stage_other" aria-label="Other career stage" disabled>
    </div>
  </fieldset>

  <fieldset class="mb-3" data-other-group="role">
    <legend class="fs-6">Which best describes your role *</legend>
    <div class="form-check">
      <input class="form-check-input" type="radio" id="r1" name="role" value="Post-graduate student (non-doctoral)" required>
      <label class="form-check-label" for="r1">Post-graduate student (non-doctoral)</label>
    </div>
    <div class="form-check">
      <input class="form-check-input" type="radio" id="r2" name="role" value="Doctoral student">
      <label class="form-check-label" for="r2">Doctoral student</label>
    </div>
    <div class="form-check">
      <input class="form-check-input" type="radio" id="r3" name="role" value="Researcher">
      <label class="form-check-label" for="r3">Researcher</label>
    </div>
    <div class="form-check">
      <input class="form-check-input" type="radio" id="r4" name="role" value="Research Software Engineer">
      <label class="form-check-label" for="r4">Research Software Engineer</label>
    </div>
    <div class="form-check">
      <input class="form-check-input" type="radio" id="r5" name="role" value="Bioinformatician">
      <label class="form-check-label" for="r5">Bioinformatician</label>
    </div>
    <div class="form-check">
      <input class="form-check-input" type="radio" id="r6" name="role" value="Open Research Specialist">
      <label class="form-check-label" for="r6">Open Research Specialist</label>
    </div>
    <div class="form-check">
      <input class="form-check-input" type="radio" id="r7" name="role" value="Research skills educator">
      <label class="form-check-label" for="r7">Research skills educator</label>
    </div>
    <div class="form-check d-flex align-items-center gap-2">
      <input class="form-check-input mt-0" type="radio" id="r8" name="role" value="Other">
      <label class="form-check-label" for="r8">Other:</label>
      <input type="text" class="form-control form-control-sm w-auto" name="role_other" aria-label="Other role" disabled>
    </div>
  </fieldset>

  <div class="mb-3">
    <label for="dtp" class="form-label">If you are completing a DTP/DLA studentship please indicate your programme/funding</label>
    <input id="dtp" name="dtp_programme" type="text" class="form-control">
  </div>

  <div class="mb-3">
    <label for="dtp_other" class="form-label">If other DTP please provide the name</label>
    <input id="dtp_other" name="dtp_other" type="text" class="form-control">
  </div>

  <div class="mb-3">
    <label for="research_area" class="form-label">Tell us more about your area of research and what training courses would be useful for you?</label>
    <textarea id="research_area" name="research_area" rows="4" class="form-control"></textarea>
  </div>

  <fieldset class="mb-3" data-other-group="heard_about">
    <legend class="fs-6">Where did you hear about the Catalyst? *</legend>
    <div class="form-check">
      <input class="form-check-input" type="radio" id="h1" name="heard_about" value="UKRI Digital Research Skills Catalyst (website or mailing list)" required>
      <label class="form-check-label" for="h1">UKRI Digital Research Skills Catalyst (website or mailing list)</label>
    </div>
    <div class="form-check">
      <input class="form-check-input" type="radio" id="h2" name="heard_about" value="Bluesky">
      <label class="form-check-label" for="h2">Bluesky</label>
    </div>
    <div class="form-check">
      <input class="form-check-input" type="radio" id="h3" name="heard_about" value="Colleague / Supervisor / PI">
      <label class="form-check-label" for="h3">Colleague / Supervisor / PI</label>
    </div>
    <div class="form-check">
      <input class="form-check-input" type="radio" id="h4" name="heard_about" value="Doctoral Landscape Training Network (website or email)">
      <label class="form-check-label" for="h4">Doctoral Landscape Training Network (website or email)</label>
    </div>
    <div class="form-check">
      <input class="form-check-input" type="radio" id="h5" name="heard_about" value="DTP/DLA newsletter">
      <label class="form-check-label" for="h5">DTP/DLA newsletter</label>
    </div>
    <div class="form-check">
      <input class="form-check-input" type="radio" id="h6" name="heard_about" value="Institutional newsletter">
      <label class="form-check-label" for="h6">Institutional newsletter</label>
    </div>
    <div class="form-check">
      <input class="form-check-input" type="radio" id="h7" name="heard_about" value="LinkedIn">
      <label class="form-check-label" for="h7">LinkedIn</label>
    </div>
    <div class="form-check">
      <input class="form-check-input" type="radio" id="h8" name="heard_about" value="Other">
      <label class="form-check-label" for="h8">Other</label>
    </div>
  </fieldset>

  <div class="mb-3">
    <label for="heard_other" class="form-label">If other please provide details</label>
    <input id="heard_other" name="heard_about_other" type="text" class="form-control">
  </div>

  <!-- Honeypot: hidden from people; bots tend to fill it in -->
  <input name="website" type="text" tabindex="-1" autocomplete="off"
         style="position:absolute;left:-9999px" aria-hidden="true">

  <!-- Remove this block if you collect consent elsewhere -->
  <div class="form-check mb-3">
    <input id="consent" name="consent" type="checkbox" value="Yes" class="form-check-input" required>
    <label for="consent" class="form-check-label">
      I agree to be added to the mailing list and understand I can unsubscribe at any time. *
    </label>
  </div>

  <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary">Submit</button>
  <p id="signup-status" role="status" class="mt-2"></p>
</form>

<script>
// ---- EDIT THIS ----------------------------------------------------------
const SCRIPT_URL = "PASTE_YOUR_APPS_SCRIPT_/exec_URL_HERE";
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------

const form = document.getElementById("signup");
const statusEl = document.getElementById("signup-status");

// "Other:" radios: enable and require the text box only when Other is chosen
document.querySelectorAll("[data-other-group]").forEach((group) => {
  const radios = group.querySelectorAll('input[type="radio"]');
  const otherText = group.querySelector('input[type="text"]');
  radios.forEach((r) => r.addEventListener("change", () => {
    const isOther = group.querySelector('input[type="radio"][value="Other"]').checked;
    otherText.disabled = !isOther;
    otherText.required = isOther;
    if (!isOther) otherText.value = "";
  }));
});

form.addEventListener("submit", async (e) => {
  e.preventDefault();
  if (!form.checkValidity()) { form.reportValidity(); return; }

  const btn = form.querySelector('button[type="submit"]');
  btn.disabled = true;
  statusEl.textContent = "Sending...";
  try {
    await fetch(SCRIPT_URL, { method: "POST", mode: "no-cors", body: new FormData(form) });
    statusEl.textContent = "Thanks, your details have been sent.";
    form.reset();
    form.querySelectorAll('input[type="text"][disabled]').forEach((i) => (i.required = false));
  } catch (err) {
    statusEl.textContent = "Something went wrong. Please try again.";
  } finally {
    btn.disabled = false;
  }
});
</script>
```
